entities.name: UniProt A4J708 HisA
observations: Exact 246-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt A4J708 from Desulforamulus reducens.
Annotated as HisA / EC 5.3.1.16, catalyzing isomerization of ProFAR to PRFAR in histidine biosynthesis.
Reference annotation places protein in cytoplasm.
Associated annotations include L-histidine biosynthesis and L-tryptophan biosynthetic process.

entities.name: L-histidine biosynthesis
observations: A4J708 HisA is annotated at step 4 of 9, converting ProFAR to PRFAR.

entities.name: L-tryptophan biosynthesis
observations: L-tryptophan biosynthetic process is included in the reference GO annotations for this exact-sequence protein; evidence is annotation-based.
